The application stands disposed of.
CM APPL. 53006/2024 (Seeking condonation of delay in filing the appeal)

The instant application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 read with Order XLI Rule 3 and Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking condonation of delay in filing the appeal.
For the sufficient cause being shown in the application, the same is allowed and the delay of 11 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2024 at 00:25:08 MAC.APP. 482/2024 & CM APPL. 53007/2024 (Stay)
1.

The instant appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"a). to allow the appeal and set aside the impugned award dated 20.05.2024 passed United India Insurance Co. Ltd vs Smt Arti & Ors on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57824246/
1 by Ms. Vrinda Kumari, Judge MACT, Patiala House, in MACT No. 193/2021, titled as "Smt. Arti & others Vs. Rajvir Singh & Others", whereby the Appellant is directed to pay Rs.39,70,975/- on account of fatal injuries sustained by the deceased, as compensation along with the interest @ 7.5% p.a. from the date of institution.
b) pass such other further order/ orders, as may be deemed fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case."
2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant submitted that there are contradictions in the contents of the FIR and chargesheet was filed by the Police after investigation.

sentences.text: It is submitted that there are several discrepancies in the award dated 20th May, 2024 (hereinafter "impugned award") passed by the learned Tribunal.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant undertakes, on instructions, to deposit the entire awarded compensation amount as per the impugned award passed by the learned Tribunal.

4. Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the appellant.
5.
Issue notice of the appeal and the accompanying application to respondents through all permissible modes on filing PF within one week.
6. This Court is, prima facie, satisfied that the matter requires consideration.

Since the matter requires consideration, this Court is inclined to grant the stay on the operation of the impugned award.
7.
Accordingly, subject to the appellant depositing the entire compensation amount along with the interest from the date of the institution This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2024 at 00:25:08 of the claim in terms of the impugned award before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
8. List on 12th November, 2024 before the Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J SEPTEMBER 11, 2024 gs/sm
